unit_rule.deduplication: first unique call_id plus target_sha256 exposure

critical_label.name: historical_fix_adjacent
critical_label.source: source_commit production diff against source_commit parent
critical_label.window: changed parent hunk lines plus or minus 5 lines
critical_label.match: normalized path and exact non-empty source text
critical_label.line_shift_fallback: same exact text within plus or minus 3 lines

validity_gate.primary: for every parsed record, reconstructed OFF KEEP/DROP vector equals captured OFF KEEP/DROP vector
validity_gate.secondary: also report full target-output SHA256 equality

analysis_constraints: do not modify task membership after replay results
do not modify critical labeling after replay results
do not modify base reconstruction after replay results
do not modify frozen TrajRel B-intersect-Q primary policy after replay results
report zero-opportunity and zero-rescue outcomes unchanged if observed
